The '''High City Council''', also known as the '''City High Council''', was the governing body of the [[High City of Refuge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]]. It was a fifteen member body selected by general election. The Council employed [[Kep Fortuna]] as a [[city manager]].
